newsitem.title: USA: Earl M. Jorgensen sets $10 mln FY98 cap spending.
newsitem.headline: Earl M. Jorgensen sets $10 mln FY98 cap spending.

text.p: Earl M. Jorgensen Co said Monday it budgeted about $10 million for capital expenditures for fiscal 1998.

In a quarterly financial filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company said that, of the total, about $7.6 million is for routine replacement of machinery and equipment and facility improvements.

It said $2.4 million will be used to further enhance its information technology systems. It expects to finance the capital expenditures from borrowings under its revolving credit and internal cash flow.

Earl M. Jorgensen is a Brea, Calif., unit of Jorgenson Holding Co. The company is a distributor of metal bars, sheets, plates, tubes, pipes and shapes made of carbon, alloy steel, stainless and specialty aluminum steel.
